10	      "body": "Adding to it: Primary hypophysitis is categorized using both histopathologic and anatomical criteria, though the anatomical subclassification applies specifically to lymphocytic hypophysitis rather than to all histologic types. Histopathologic classification divides primary hypophysitis into lymphocytic, granulomatous, xanthomatous, IgG4-related, and necrotizing types. Mixed forms (such as lymphogranulomatous or xanthogranulomatous) are also recognized. As commented above, lymphocytic hypophysitis is the most common histologic variant.\n\nAnatomical classification further subdivides lymphocytic hypophysitis based on the affected region into three types: lymphocytic adenohypophysitis (LAH, affecting the anterior pituitary), lymphocytic infundibuloneurohypophysitis (LINH, affecting the posterior pituitary and stalk), and lymphocytic panhypophysitis (LPH, affecting both anterior and posterior regions). #!/bin/sh
# Wrapper script for docker.
#
# This is used primarily for wrapping the GNU Make workflow.
# Instead of typing "make TARGET", type "./run.sh make TARGET".
# This will run the make workflow within a docker container.
#
# The assumption is that you are working in the src/ontology folder;
# we therefore map the whole repo (../..) to a docker volume.
#
# See README-editors.md for more details.

MEMORY_GB=${MEMORY_GB:-8}
IMAGE=${IMAGE:-odkfull:v1.6}
MEMORY_JAVA="-Xmx${MEMORY_GB}G"
ODK_DEBUG=${ODK_DEBUG:-no}

docker pull obolibrary/$IMAGE

echo "Running ODK with ${MEMORY_GB} GB of memory, using ${IMAGE}."

TIMECMD=
if [ x$ODK_DEBUG = xyes ]; then
    # If you wish to change the format string, take care of using
    # non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) instead of normal spaces, to
    # prevent the shell from tokenizing the format string.
    TIMECMD="/usr/bin/time -f ### DEBUG STATS ###\nElapsed time: %E\nPeak memory: %M kb"
fi

docker run --memory=${MEMORY_GB}g  -v $PWD/../../:/work -w /work/src/ontology -e ROBOT_JAVA_ARGS=${MEMORY_JAVA} -e JAVA_OPTS=${MEMORY_JAVA} --rm -ti obolibrary/$IMAGE $TIMECMD "$@"

# Fix synonym scope on MONDO:0019835 (primary hypophysitis)

Addresses issue #9859.

## Background

@galyea123 reported that MONDO:0019835 (primary hypophysitis) lists "lymphocytic hypophysitis" and "autoimmune hypophysitis" as EXACT synonyms, but this is incorrect:

- **Primary hypophysitis** is a parent category that, per clinical literature, includes several histopathological subtypes:
  - Lymphocytic
  - Granulomatous
  - Xanthomatous
  - IgG4-related
  - Necrotizing
  (plus mixed forms such as lymphogranulomatous / xanthogranulomatous)
- **Lymphocytic hypophysitis** is the *most common* histopathologic subtype, often used interchangeably with **autoimmune hypophysitis** in the literature, but it is not equivalent to the parent.
- Anatomical subclassification (LAH, LINH, LPH) applies specifically to lymphocytic hypophysitis.

References cited by the reporter:
- https://journals.lww.com/neur/fulltext/2018/66020/diagnosis_and_management_of_lymphocytic.23.aspx
- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562255/

The reporter noted they are also writing to Orphanet for clarification, so I have deliberately kept changes minimal and reversible.

## Changes made

On `MONDO:0019835` (primary hypophysitis):

- Changed `synonym: "autoimmune hypophysitis" EXACT [...]` → `NARROW`
- Changed `synonym: "lymphocytic hypophysitis" EXACT [...]` → `NARROW`
- Added an editor `comment:` summarising the rationale and pointing to the issue
- Added `property_value: IAO:0000233 "https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo/issues/9859" xsd:anyURI` (term_tracker_item)

The synonym xref provenance ([NCIT:C132055], [Orphanet:95506]) was preserved.

## What I intentionally did NOT do

- I did not remove or alter the `xref:` to `NCIT:C132055` and `Orphanet:95506` (both still marked `MONDO:equivalentTo`). These mappings are debatable given the same terminological confusion the issue is about, but resolving them likely requires Orphanet's response and possibly creating a new dedicated MONDO term for lymphocytic/autoimmune hypophysitis. Leaving the xrefs unchanged keeps existing mapping integrations stable until that decision is made.
- I did not mint a new MONDO child term for "lymphocytic hypophysitis" / "autoimmune hypophysitis". Existing children of primary hypophysitis (adenohypophysitis, panhypophysitis, infundibulo-neurohypophysitis) already represent the anatomical subdivisions; the histopathologic subdivision is currently not modelled and is a separate scope decision.
- I did not touch obvious sibling terms (`MONDO:0023282` granulomatous hypophysitis, etc.) — they are out of scope for this issue.

## Checklist

- [x] Located the target term via `obo-grep.pl`
- [x] Reviewed children of primary hypophysitis to understand existing structure
- [x] Checked the term out with `obo-checkout.pl`, edited the small stanza
- [x] Synonym scopes downgraded EXACT → NARROW (per OBO synonym scope semantics for "synonym refers to a more specific concept")
- [x] Editor comment added explaining the rationale
- [x] `term_tracker_item` (IAO:0000233) link added pointing to issue #9859
- [x] Checked back in with `obo-checkin.pl`
- [x] Ran `sh run.sh make NORM && mv NORM mondo-edit.obo` to normalise serialisation
- [x] Verified diff is scoped only to MONDO:0019835
